items.title: JLR to raise 2 billion loan from global banks to refinance debt
items.summary: At the end of FY26, JLR had 5.4 billion of debt outstanding, comprising 1.8 billion of unsecured bonds, 2.9 billion of unsecured loans and 38 million of other debt, according to the company’s annual report.

items.title: Maruti Suzuki’s domestic sales surge 39.5% to record 1.94 lakh units in May
items.summary: The highest-ever monthly domestic sales helped the carmaker achieve a record total sales volume of 2.43 lakh units, supported by robust demand for SUVs and compact cars.

items.title: Tata Advanced Systems adds navigation, optronics capabilities to JLR vehicles, says Chandrasekaran
items.summary: Tata Sons Chairman N Chandrasekaran highlighted the growing synergies within the Tata Group, citing Tata Advanced Systems' contributions to Jaguar Land Rover vehicles for military applications through advanced navigation, optronics and armouring solutions.

items.title: China's SAIC plans to build first EU car plant in Spain's Galicia
items.summary: China's SAIC Motor Corp plans its first EU production facility in Spain's Galicia region, with an initial €200 million investment. This move aligns with a broader trend of Chinese automakers establishing production in Spain.

items.title: Kia India posts highest-ever May sales, wholesale dispatches rise 24% to 27,586 units
items.summary: The automaker said the performance was supported by sustained demand across its product portfolio, particularly the new Seltos, Sonet, Carens Clavis, Clavis EV and the MY26 Syros.

items.title: RSB Transmissions acquires Setco Auto Systems to strengthen commercial vehicle components business
items.summary: The acquisition expands RSB's footprint in the automotive components sector and adds clutch systems to its portfolio of drivetrain products.

items.title: Mahindra posts 11% growth in May SUV sales at 58,021 units
items.summary: Total vehicle sales, including exports, rose to 99,636 units, while three-wheeler volumes surged 89% during the month.

items.title: Atul Auto, Exponent Energy partner to roll out 15-minute charging electric three-wheelers
items.summary: The tie-up will integrate 15-minute rapid charging technology into factory-built vehicles, aiming to accelerate EV adoption in the commercial segment.

items.title: Tata Motors turns to Chery platform for Avinya EVs after JLR roadmap setback
items.summary: The first Avinya model based on Chery's platform is expected to be launched in 2027, with a second model planned for 2029.

items.title: PV sales stay resilient in May despite fuel price hike; Maruti, Mahindra and Tata lead the pack
items.summary: Industry clocks around 4.4 lakh units in May as strong demand for CNG vehicles and EVs helps offset concerns over rising fuel prices and geopolitical uncertainty.

items.title: Tata AutoComp Partners With Jahwa Electronics for EV Component Manufacturing
items.summary: Tata AutoComp Systems Limited has entered into a joint venture agreement with South Korea based Jahwa Electronics to locally manufacture and supply advanced thermal management solutions for the Indian automotive market. The partnership will focus on the production of low-voltage and high-voltage positive temperature coefficient (PTC) heaters to address growing component demand in the electric and hybrid vehicle se...

items.title: BYD snaps longest streak of sales declines
items.summary: Chinese EV giant BYD broke its sales decline streak in May, with global sales rising 0.3 per cent to 383,453 units. This growth was driven by strong overseas shipments, which surged 80.4 per cent, offsetting a 24 per cent drop in domestic sales amid fierce competition and weakening demand.

items.title: Tata Motors PV sales rise 42% to 59,090 units in May; EV volumes hit record 10,517
items.summary: Electric vehicle sales emerged as a key growth driver, with combined domestic and export volumes rising 85% year-on-year to a record 10,517 units, compared with 5,685 units in May 2025.

items.title: Amara Raja plans ₹1,700 crore capex push for FY27; targets Q1 FY28 lithium plant launch
items.summary: The lead acid battery manufacturer through its new energy business unit, Amara Raja Advanced Technologies, is targeting a total cell manufacturing capacity of 16GWh in a phased manner by 2030.

items.title: TVS Srichakra Approves Rs 220 Crore Capex for Capacity Expansion at Madurai Plants
items.summary: The board of directors of TVS Srichakra Limited has approved a capital investment of up to Rs 220 crore to expand production capacities at its manufacturing facilities located in Vellaripatti, Madurai. The decision was finalized during a board meeting on May 27, 2026, according to a regulatory filing submitted to the stock exchanges.

items.title: JK Tyre Unveils One Of Its Largest Capex Plans As Capacity Utilisation Crosses 90%
items.summary: JK Tyre & Industries Ltd has announced one of its largest-ever capital expenditure plans, approving a Rs 4,980 crore phased expansion of its truck and passenger car radial tyre capacities amid strong demand across domestic and export markets. The expansion, approved by the company’s board, will increase overall capacity by 24% over the next three years and will primarily focus on the Chennai and Mysore plants.

items.title: JK Tyre Q4 Net Profit Rises 83%; Approves Rs 4,980 Crore Capacity Expansion Plan
items.summary: JK Tyre & Industries reported an 83 percent year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit for the fourth quarter of FY2026 and announced a Rs 4,980 crore capacity expansion programme for truck, bus and passenger car radial tyres as it prepares for rising domestic demand. The company’s board approved phased expansion of Truck & Bus Radial (TBR) tyre capacity at its Chennai Tyre Plant and Vikrant Tyre Plant, alon...

items.title: Tata AutoComp forms JV with Korea’s Jahwa Electronics for EV heater systems
items.summary: T​he joint venture will position India as a strategic manufacturing and supply hub for Jahwa Electronics, leveraging growing demand for electrified mobility solutions in the country.

items.title: Tesla May registrations jump in several European markets as recovery continues
items.summary: Tesla car sales are showing a strong comeback in Europe. Registrations surged in countries like Sweden, Denmark, and Spain. France saw a remarkable jump in new Tesla vehicles. Policy support and fuel costs are driving buyers towards cleaner vehicles.
